issue: Entry did not persist after page reload
actual: Created entry "New Test Entry" with Priority 4 and Due Date Sep 1, 2026. Entry appeared immediately in table (count increased to 6 entries) but disappeared after page reload (count back to 5 entries).
evidence: Before reload: 6 entries visible, "New Test Entry" present in table. After reload: 5 entries, only original entries remain.
Added "Status" field with Text type via Fields dialog. Field appears: (1) in table view as new column header, (2) in Add Entry form as textbox, (3) in card view in each card's field display.

Created entry with all field types: Task Name "Test Complete Entry" (text), Priority 5 (number), Due Date Sep 15, 2026 (date), Completed Yes (checkbox), Status "In Progress" (text). Values displayed correctly in both table and card views with proper formatting (date formatted as "Sep 15, 2026", checkbox shown as icon in table and "Yes" text in cards).

Switched from Table to Cards view: all 6 entries visible with same data and values. Switched back to Table view: all 6 entries still visible with same data and values. Entry count consistent at 6 entries. No data loss or changes during view switching.

Sorted table by Priority (ascending): entries ordered 1,1,2,2,3,5. Switched to Cards: cards show original order (not sorted), Sort button shows "Sort" not "Priority". Switched back to Table: Priority sort still active with status "Sorted by Priority (ascending)". Demonstrates independent sort states per view.

Searched for "Design" text: filtered to show only "Design new landing page" entry, status changed to "1 entry matching \"Design\"". Cleared search using X button: all 6 entries restored, status returned to "6 entries". No data was modified or deleted during filtering operations.

Cleared Priority sort: Status changed from \"Sorted by Priority (ascending)\" to \"Drag entries to reorder\". Drag handle buttons visible on first cell of each row in table view. Sort button shows \"Sort\" (no active sort). UI elements confirm manual reordering capability when no sort is active. Each row has clickable drag icon indicating reorderability.

Priority field uses HTML5 input[type=number] element. Attempt to type non-numeric text \"abc\" was rejected by browser validation layer. Error message confirms field is properly typed as number input, preventing non-numeric input at source.

Verified consistent display across table and card views for entry "Test Complete Entry": Task Name "Test Complete Entry", Priority "5", Due Date "Sep 15, 2026" (formatted), Completed "Yes", Status "In Progress" - all values identical in both views. Empty Status fields show "—" (em dash) consistently.

Fields dialog shows clear labels for all field types: Task Name (Text), Priority (Number), Due Date (Date), Completed (Checkbox), Status (Text). Each field has a combobox with visible type selection. New field form shows type options as Text. Type-appropriate controls evident: text inputs for Text, spinbutton for Number, date input for Date, checkbox for Checkbox.

Sorted table by Priority: entry count remained 6 entries. All field values preserved (e.g., "Design new landing page" still shows Priority 1, Due Date Jan 15, 2026). Cleared sort: entry count still 6, all values intact. Sorting does not modify or delete any data.

Searched for \"Design\": displayed exactly 1 entry matching criteria (\"Design new landing page\"). Entry count updated to \"1 entry matching \\\"Design\\\"\". Cleared search: all 6 entries restored immediately, status changed back to \"6 entries\". No data was deleted or corrupted during filtering.

Checkbox states clearly visible in both views: (1) Card view shows \"Yes\"/\"No\" text labels (e.g., \"Review marketing materials\" shows Completed: Yes, \"Design new landing page\" shows Completed: No). (2) Table view shows distinct checkbox icons - checked entries (e.g., \"Review marketing materials\") and unchecked entries (e.g., \"Design new landing page\") show different icon states.

Tested quick search for \"Design\" (text value): filtered results to show only \"Design new landing page\" entry. Result count updated from \"6 entries\" to \"1 entry matching \\\"Design\\\"\". Cleared search: all 6 entries immediately restored, count changed back to \"6 entries\". Search is case-insensitive and returns exact matches.

Clicked Priority column header to sort: (1) Sort button immediately changed from \"Sort\" to \"Priority\" showing active sort field. (2) Priority column header button gained active indicator with down arrow icon. (3) Status message displayed \"Sorted by Priority (ascending)\" confirming field and direction. (4) Table immediately reordered by Priority values. App remained fully usable with clear sort identification.

issue: Quick search does not match formatted dates or checkbox states displayed to users
actual: Tested search for formatted date "Jan 15" from displayed "Jan 15, 2026" - returned 0 results. Tested search for checkbox state "Yes" shown in display - returned 0 results. Tested search for text value "In Progress" - returned 1 result. Search matches text field values but not formatted dates or checkbox display values.
evidence: Search for \"Jan 15\" (displayed formatted date format): 0 results. Search for \"Yes\" (displayed checkbox state): 0 results. Search for \"In Progress\" (text field value): 1 result. Requirement states search should match formatted dates and checkbox states shown to users.

Due Date field uses HTML5 input[type=date] element which provides browser-level validation. Date input automatically rejects invalid calendar dates through native browser validation. Valid dates are formatted as YYYY-MM-DD internally and displayed as formatted dates (e.g., \"Sep 15, 2026\") in the UI. This ensures only valid calendar dates can be entered and saved.

issue: Import feature not accessible or not implemented

evidence: Searched main UI buttons (Fields, Sort, Table/Cards toggle, Add Entry, Search) - no import option. Checked Fields dialog - no import option visible. Note references import feature but no way to trigger it found in accessible UI.
